description: CR 603.2 two Squires make the lone attacker 5/5
note: Two exalted permanents are two abilities and two +1/+1s, which is CR 603.2 rather than a clause of rule 702.83: unlike shadow, exalted prints no "multiple instances are redundant" sentence. alice's Hill Giant attacks alone while both Aven Squires stay home; the reading is taken at the combat damage step, before damage.
